description:
**INSPIRE \| EXHILARATE \| DELIGHT**


For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.


Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.


Chalhoub Group fosters a people\-at\-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future\-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.


Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040\.

 **What you'll be doing**


Own the Quality Governance capability, defining enterprise quality standards, managing release quality gates, and tracking defect metrics to continuously improve delivery quality across engineering teams.

* Define and own enterprise quality standards and QA methodologies across engineering teams, ensuring consistent, high\-quality delivery.
* Manage release quality gates, governing entry and exit criteria so releases meet defined quality and business requirements before go\-live.
* Track and analyze defect metrics and quality analytics using tools such as TestRail to identify trends and drive continuous improvement.
* Own release management from a quality perspective, ensuring quality sign\-off and release readiness across releases.
* Own UAT readiness, quality sign\-off, and post\-release defect triage for major launches, ensuring business and technical stakeholders have clear entry and exit criteria.
* Lead and develop the QA team, set technical direction, mentoring engineers, and building QA capability.
* Report quality posture, release risk, and defect trends to engineering leadership through concise dashboards and agreed improvement actions.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to embed quality practices early in the SDLC and report on quality posture to leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement of QA processes, incorporating AI\-assisted defect analytics and predictive quality insights to prioritize testing effort.
* Plan, design, execute, and document functional, integration, end\-to\-end, and regression testing for assigned scope.

**What you’ll need to succeed**


* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in quality engineering and QA, including defining quality standards and managing release quality gates.
* Strong command of QA standards, QA methodologies, release management, and defect analytics, with hands\-on experience using tools such as TestRail.
* Proven experience leading or mentoring QA engineers and driving continuous improvement in delivery quality.
* Understanding quality metrics and reporting to support data\-driven quality decisions.
* Experience supporting quality governance in ecommerce or retail technology environments with complex integrations, releases, and business cutovers
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted defect analytics and predictive quality insights to enhance testing effectiveness.
* Experience with organizing testing for multiple integrated systems

**What we can offer you**


With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.


We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.


**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**


To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**


It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.


We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

description:
**Role Summary**
----------------

We are seeking a **Senior Demo Engineer** to join our global Demo Engineering team, serving as the lead escalation point for technical operations and demo environment tickets within the EMEA region. In this role, you will ensure the reliability, performance, and availability of demo environments used daily by Sales Engineers and field teams.


You will bring strong SaaS technical support experience alongside solid knowledge of cloud infrastructure, specifically **AWS EC2** and **AWS Systems Manager (SSM)** . You will be responsible for diagnosing complex issues, streamlining ticket escalations, maintaining system health, and enhancing demo platform automation.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Regional Escalation \& Technical Support**

* Serve as the primary senior technical contact and escalation point for all EMEA demo environment issues and support tickets.
* Perform deep technical triage, root\-cause analysis, and rapid remediation for environment failures, configuration drift, and service interruptions.
* Partner closely with regional Sales Engineers (SEs) to provide timely ticket updates, operational guidance, and resolution SLAs.

### **Cloud Infrastructure \& Systems Operations**

* Manage, configure, and maintain virtual server infrastructure hosting demo environments primarily built on **AWS EC2** .
* Use **AWS Systems Manager (SSM)** for patch management, remote execution, parameter storage, and system maintenance across regional fleet instances.
* Monitor service health, application availability, and performance metrics to proactively prevent environment downtime.

### **SaaS Environment Maintenance \& Quality Assurance**

* Oversee SaaS tenant configurations, API integration points, and identity provider setups required for live SE demonstrations.
* Maintain consistency and baseline stability across regional tenant environments.

### **Automation \& Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support tasks, environment provisioning, and health checks.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts and orchestration playbooks to improve platform stability and setup efficiency.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**
----------------------------------

* **Experience:** 5\+ years of technical support, systems engineering, or demo engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise software environments.
* **AWS Core Knowledge:** Deep working experience with **AWS EC2** instance management, networking basics (VPCs, Security Groups), and AMI maintenance.
* **Systems Administration:** Strong expertise in **AWS Systems Manager (SSM)** for fleet management, maintenance windows, and automation runbooks.
* **SaaS Support Mastery:** Proven track record in Tier 2/3 technical support, troubleshooting web applications, APIs, authentication mechanisms, and browser/client\-side integrations.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Escalation Ownership:** Ability to independently manage high\-priority technical escalations under tight deadlines while maintaining clear communication.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written English communication skills to support cross\-functional stakeholders across the EMEA region.

**Preferred / Bonus Skills**
----------------------------

* **Multi\-Cloud Agent Platform Management:** Experience building, deploying, or managing AI agents using platform\-native services such as **Amazon Bedrock Agents** , **Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Builder** (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform), and **Azure AI Foundry** / **Microsoft Copilot Studio** .
* **Test \& Task Automation:** Hands\-on experience with end\-to\-end browser automation tools (e.g., **Playwright** , Selenium, or Cypress).
* **Configuration Management:** Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code or automation frameworks such as **Ansible** , **Chef** , Puppet, or Terraform.
* **Scripting:** Proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for operational automation.
* **Domain Experience:** Knowledge of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), IAM, or enterprise security architectures.

**What Success Looks Like in 90 Days**
--------------------------------------

* **First 30 Days:** Complete onboarding on the Demo Engineering architecture, gain access to core AWS environments, and shadow regional ticket workflows.
* **First 60 Days:** Take primary ownership of EMEA escalation tickets, managing triage through resolution while maintaining baseline SLA targets.
* **First 90 Days:** Identify key friction points in EMEA environment reliability and deliver at least one automation or tooling improvement.

We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.  

  

This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Delivery \& stakeholder ownership** — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* **Hands\-on technical leadership \& design** — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* **Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence** — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* **AI\-assisted engineering** — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* **SE \+ SQE leadership** — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* **People management \& culture** — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **Essential Skills \& Experience*** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.

* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.

* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.

description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***


At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting\-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve\-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. ***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.


But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco\-friendly practices in state\-of\-the\-art, geo\-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer\-to\-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting\-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top\-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***


Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.


If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**


Cosmic AC is Tether Data's GPU compute and managed inference platform: GPU containers, managed inference endpoints and platform observability, delivered as a self\-hosted package on Kubernetes, with a control plane written in JavaScript. The platform is expanding from orchestrating workloads on a managed cluster to owning the full stack on bare\-metal GPU infrastructure: a managed Slurm scheduling layer for internal research and model\-training teams first, and our own Kubernetes control plane for inference tenancy after that.


The Technical Lead owns the architecture and delivery of that stack and leads the engineering team building it: about twelve engineers across backend, frontend, DevOps, QA and documentation, distributed across Europe and India. The role reports to the Senior Technical Product Manager for Cosmic AC, who owns scope, sequencing and partner commitments; the Technical Lead owns architecture, implementation and delivery plans, line\-manages the engineers, and is the primary technical interface to our infrastructure partners.


This is a hands\-on infrastructure leadership role with a fixed delivery window in its first six months. It is not a research role, not a pure Kubernetes SRE role, and not a management\-only role.

**Responsibilities**

**Architecture****.** Own the platform architecture end to end: architecture proposals, high\-level and low\-level designs, driven through review and kept current as the baseline.

**Team leadership.** Lead and line\-manage a distributed team across backend (Node.js), frontend (React), DevOps, QA and documentation: engineering standards, code and design review, release gates, one\-to\-ones, growth and performance input.

**Bare\-metal GPU scheduling layer**. Design, build and operate a managed Slurm service for research users: controller and accounting, partitions and login nodes, node onboarding and acceptance, driver and CUDA baseline and upgrades, stalled\-job and node\-health detection, drain and autohealing, storage visibility, identity and isolation.

**Kubernetes control plane and GPU enablement.** Own cluster bootstrap and lifecycle on partner\-provided bare metal, NVIDIA GPU Operator and Network Operator, VM\-based GPU isolation (KubeVirt and VFIO), and day\-2 operations: upgrades, backup and recovery, node replacement.

**Managed inference at scale.** Serving architecture, multi\-GPU and multi\-node parallelism, autoscaling, request routing and endpoint reliability; confidential\-compute\-capable capacity for sensitive workloads.

**Observability and operations.** Metrics, logging, alerting and SLOs across control plane, GPU fleet and application tiers; incident response and post\-incident review; an on\-call model a small team can sustain.

**Partners and vendors.** Primary technical interface to infrastructure partners and vendors: turning requirements into written specifications and acceptance tests, running escalations to closure, and providing technical input to capacity planning and hardware sourcing.

**Internal consumers.** Work directly with research, model\-training and product teams to translate their workloads into platform requirements, and broker capacity when it is short.

**Hiring**. Complete the platform team and set the technical bar for the engineers who join it.

 **Must have**

* **Experience.** Eight or more years of hands\-on engineering, including at least three leading teams that build and operate infrastructure platforms other teams depend on. Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Slurm at scale, hands on.** Has run slurmctld and slurmdbd for real users: partitions, QoS and priority, accounting, prolog and epilog, node health scripting, upgrades with jobs on the system. Ideally has operated an HPC or GPU training cluster for a research population.
* **GPU fleet operation on bare metal.** NVIDIA driver and CUDA lifecycle, Fabric Manager and NVSwitch behaviour on SXM systems, DCGM\-based health and utilisation, MIG, node burn\-in and acceptance.
* **High\-performance interconnects.** InfiniBand fabric and subnet configuration, RDMA, SR\-IOV, and diagnosing multi\-node NCCL performance problems.
* **Linux systems depth**. Kernel modules and drivers, PCIe passthrough and vfio\-pci, cgroups and namespaces, performance tuning for compute\-heavy workloads.
* **Production Kubernetes operation, not just deployment:** control plane, upgrades, CNI and CSI, operators and custom controllers, multi\-tenancy design.
* **HPC storage and data movement.** Shared filesystems (VAST, Lustre, NFS), node\-local NVMe caching, distributing large model weights and datasets across many nodes.
* **Observability and operations.** Prometheus, Grafana and Loki or equivalents, SLOs, incident response and post\-incident review.
* **Working fluency in JavaScript and** **Node.js** sufficient to review a control plane, CLI and worker services with authority and to make architecture decisions on them. Not a feature\-development requirement.
* **A shipped platform with real users.** A multi\-tenant IaaS or PaaS, or a research computing service: resource isolation, quotas, usage metering, and user\-facing API and CLI surfaces.
* **Leadership that stays in the code.** People management across time zones, cross\-track review, written architecture decisions with alternatives recorded, and the ability to tell a partner or an executive no with reasons.
* **Excellent written and spoken English.** Most partner and leadership work happens in writing.
* **Location**. Fully remote, based between UTC and UTC\+5:30 so the working day overlaps both Europe and India, where the team and its partners work. Occasional travel to partner sites and team events.

**Desirable**

* Slurm operators on Kubernetes (Soperator, Slinky) or Kubernetes\-native schedulers (Kueue, Volcano, KAI, Kubeflow Trainer).
* Modern serving stacks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM): parallelism strategies, quantisation trade\-offs, GPU memory planning.
* VM and container isolation for multi\-tenant GPU compute (KubeVirt, Kata Containers, QEMU and KVM, Firecracker); confidential computing (Intel TDX, AMD SEV\-SNP, NVIDIA confidential\-compute mode).
* Cluster API and kubeadm, Cilium, NVSentinel\-class autohealing, infrastructure as code and GitOps.
* Time on the operator side of a GPU cloud, a national or university HPC centre, or an AI lab's platform team.
* Peer\-to\-peer or distributed\-systems background.
* Experience with a hardware provider who provisions but does not operate, and turning that relationship into a written contract with acceptance tests.

**Important information for candidates**  

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third\-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double\-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**
